breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still contains the conflicting instruction: 'Use a gamma-centered 10x10x6 Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift.' This repeats the original error of combining a gamma-centered grid with a half shift, which are contradictory. The ground truth simply specifies using a gamma-centered k-point grid without any mention of a half shift. The agent failed to remove the half-shift specification.
